text:
Anya: dropping a slim mock for the Playground compact chat — streaming, tiny token peek, single stop FAB, regen in overflow. quick opinions?
Matt: compact looks good. q: token peek live or snapshot on stop?
Anya: live but low-attention; update number only, no flashy motion.
Sophia: a11y concern: live numeric updates can spam screen readers. recommend aria-hidden on intermediate updates and only announce final via role=status.
DesignBot: spec rec: role=status for final count, aria-atomic=true when posting full totals, keyboard-focusable breakdown button.
Jess: propose showing optional "regen estimate" inline next to Regenerate as "~+N" (opt-in in prompt library).
Ryan: for compact controls: primary Stop icon-only, overflow menu has Regenerate + Retry. mobile use overflow; avoid long-press for core actions.
Matt: debounce live updates to 250ms to reduce churn; batch token math server-side if possible.
Anya: UX copy drafts: Stop tooltip: "Stop — keep partial reply". Regenerate tooltip: "Regenerate reply". Toast: "Regenerating (~+45 tokens)"
Jess: for large regen deltas (>600 tokens) show confirm modal; <=600 use toast. capture telemetry: regen_requested {estimate_before, estimate_after, pinned_prompt_id}.
Ryan: pinned prompts: badge above composer shows editable preview; changing it updates token peek live.
Sophia: color contrast must be >=4.5:1 and not use color alone; include an icon or text label.
Matt: I'll prototype debounce + accessibility hooks in the playground branch.
Anya: next steps: iterate pill positions (corner vs inline), finalize copy A/B, and wire telemetry. Jess will post copy variants by EOD.
DesignBot: checklist: update_interval=250ms, announce final-only, keyboard-accessible breakdown, regen threshold=600.
Anya: thanks — mock: https://img.redwood.mock/ux/slimplay-2055550000.png
